title: PrivCert: Certifying Statement Support under Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2609.38934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Differentially private (DP) text generation can protect individual records, but privacy alone does not specify what evidence a released statement carries about the underlying data. We identify this as an evidence gap: a private report may contain plausible claims without indicating whether they are strongly supported by the private dataset. We introduce PrivCert, a framework for privacy-preserving reporting that makes statement support explicit through privacy-preserving certificates and emit-or-abstain decisions. As a canonical instantiation, PrivCert-PF (Proposal-and-Filter) separates data-independent candidate discovery from private support certification, emitting only statements whose support passes a private evidence test. translated_title: PrivCert：差分隐私下的陈述支持认证
translated_abstract: 差分隐私（DP）文本生成能够保护个人记录，但仅靠隐私性并不能说明所发布陈述携带了关于底层数据的何种证据。我们将此问题识别为“证据缺口”：一份隐私报告可能包含看似合理的声明，却没有表明这些声明是否得到私有数据集的强有力支持。我们提出 PrivCert，一个隐私保护报告框架，通过隐私保护证书和“发布或弃权”决策使陈述支持度显式化。作为一个典型实例化，PrivCert-PF（提案-过滤，Proposal-and-Filter）将与数据无关的候选发现和私有支持认证分离开来，仅发布其支持度通过私有证据测试的陈述。我们为该框架提供了理论基础：刻画了差分隐私下隐式证据的极限，推导出单条陈述认证的精确隐私-诚实性边界，并建立了一个 w……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 PrivCert 框架，通过隐私保护证书和“发布或弃权”机制，在差分隐私文本生成中显式认证陈述对私有数据的支持程度，弥合隐私报告中的“证据缺口”问题。
en_tdlr: PrivCert is a framework that makes statement support explicit under differential privacy through privacy-preserving certificates and emit-or-abstain decisions, bridging the evidence gap where private reports may contain plausible but unverified claims.
